title: Fork-handled copper-alloy wire coil annealing: 7.5 tonnes per batch including the rack
summary: Suneng’s proposed furnace allows a maximum 7.5-tonne charge including the coil rack. Effective chamber dimensions are 2.4 m long × 2.5 m wide × 1.8 m high. Coil count depends on rack tare, individual coil weights and the positions actually available on the rack.
seoTitle: Copper-coil annealing: net load versus rack weight
seoDescription: The 2023 proposal specifies 7.5 tonnes including the rack. Calculate the weight limit and the available coil positions before estimating net copper per batch.

forkReview.note: The separate 2020 four-chamber contract allows 5.5 tonnes including the rack. This 7.5-tonne proposal concerns a different furnace. Calculate coil count using actual rack tare, coil weights and the agreed loading envelope.
work: 2.4 m long × 2.5 m wide × 1.8 m high. For coil layout, also check the usable loading envelope and rack drawing.
With an assumed 0.7-tonne rack and 0.8-tonne coils, the weight limit permits at most 8 coils.
features: The 7.5 tonnes includes the charge and rack. Only the remaining allowance is available for coils.
Check outside diameter, width and rack layout. Use the lower of the weight and space limits.
Use the complete cycle for shift output
Heat-up and soaking total 8 hours. Allow additional time for handling and waits while the furnace is occupied.

cards.title: Which dimensions should be used for the coil layout?
paragraphs: The proposed effective chamber measures 2.4 m × 2.5 m × 1.8 m. Use the agreed loading envelope, actual rack, coil diameter and width to draw the layout. For mixed loads, sum individual weights and confirm each position. The proposal allows 3 hours for heating and 5 for soaking. Include handling and waits when calculating shift output.

figure.caption: The proposed maximum of 7.5 tonnes includes the rack. Count the complete coils that fit the rack and compare with the weight-based limit. Six coils at 0.8 tonnes give 4.8 tonnes of copper alloy. Confirm rack weight and loading pattern for each batch.

forkReview.faqIntro: Rack-inclusive ratings in two documents and the assumptions behind a coil count.
faq: Can the 5.5 tonnes in the four-chamber contract be used for this proposal?
The 2020 four-chamber contract specifies 5.5 tonnes per chamber including the rack. The 2023 proposal specifies 7.5 tonnes including the rack for different equipment.
Why does the six-coil example also total 5.5 tonnes?
Six coils at 0.8 tonnes weigh 4.8 tonnes net. Add the assumed 0.7-tonne rack to obtain 5.5 tonnes gross.
If the weight limit allows eight coils, can eight be scheduled?
Check the available rack positions. Outside diameter, coil width and usable space determine how many whole coils can be loaded.
forkReview.source: Reference: 2023 electric chamber annealing furnace proposal, sections 2–4. The comparison uses the 2020 chamber-furnace purchase contract and Suneng’s clarification of the load composition.
